additional_info.subject: ID0379947-DC/Si-D/CZ[170001596] - Coap polling error CRM:00315001788
additional_info.body:
Dear Tomas,
Thank you for reaching out to eMobility Support. My name is
Francisco
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
MP / R3 170001596
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
hXcXbF
Problem Description
: Coap polling error
Troubleshooting
:
The SECC is indeed acting a bit faulty. From side I can propose to apply a hotfix for the modbus communication. This is already installed in many many chargers around the world and it's known to have no issues.
I would like to test this before replacing the component.
What is your opinion?
For future reference, your ticket number is
0379947
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Francisco de Matos Joaquim
Please do not
change
the
subject of this Email when
replying
to it.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0379947-DC/Si-D/CZ[170001596] - Coap polling error CRM:00315001788
additional_info.body:
Dear Francsico,
Thank you for your fast reply.
About the hotfix the answer is yes! If there is anything that could help please do it so.
The hotfix is directly performed on the EcoG device or in the PLC?
I think we have more chargers with this issue. Should I open a ticket of any of these that we faced this error before, or are you or me able to check whether the hotfix is applied there already?
Thank you
BR Tomas

additional_info.body:
Hello Francsico again,
We have 4pcs charger we would like to check and if this is the case to apply the modbus HF update.

170001597 – LxXnZ1

Thank you for this!
BR Tomas
